goa trance.name: Proto-goa
goa trance.note: c. 1983-1991. New beat, EBM and acid house played on DAT at the Goa parties, predicting the sound.

sources.note: EBM, classic and acid trance as roots

goa trance.name: Origins
goa trance.note: c. 1991-1993. The first goa trance records; Musicmap dates the genre to 1993.

goa trance.name: Golden era
goa trance.note: c. 1994-1997. London labels (Dragonfly, TIP, Flying Rhino, Blue Room Released), Astral Projection, Hallucinogen, Juno Reactor; Oakenfold's Goa Mix.

sources.note: Early history of goa trance/psytrance list: to verify

goa trance.name: Transition to psytrance
goa trance.note: c. 1998-early 2000s. Sound turns more metallic; full-on, progressive and dark psytrance emerge.

goa trance.name: New school goa
goa trance.note: c. 2000s onward. Revival with detailed production; Suntrip Records, Goasia, Artha, Morphic Resonance.
